name: sliding-indicator
title: Sliding Indicator
description: One highlight per group that glides between tabs, segmented options, toggle items or nav links. Finds the selected item from ARIA / Base UI attributes (or follows pointer and keyboard focus), glides with Motion layout projection on the smooth spring, re-places without motion on resize and RTL. Pill or underline.

name: morph-label
title: Morph Label
description: Content that crossfades between states while its box morphs to the new width (transform-only layout projection; useMorphRoot gives the box the label's spring). The outgoing label is hidden from assistive tech while it fades.

name: collapse
title: Collapse
description: Height-auto disclosure for non-Base-UI uses: eases between 0 and auto with the content fading, reverses from the current height, clips only while moving, keeps closed content inert, unmounts or keeps it mounted.

name: content-swap
title: Content Swap
description: Skeleton to content: the placeholder drops away while the content resolves into focus and the box morphs between their heights so the page below moves with it. Both directions, aria-busy while loading.

name: presence-list
title: Presence List
description: Insert, remove and reorder animation for lists and table rows (<PresenceList as="tbody"> + <PresenceItem as="tr">): exits fade in place, the rest FLIP on translate only, measured against the list so a moving list doesn't make rows glide. Works with memoized rows.
